needed.evidence: No footway on the left side of the road, pedestrians must walk in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The right sidewalk is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and ensure the right sidewalk is clear and fully usable for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right sidewalk
needed.suggestion: Repair and level the uneven sections of the right sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: No crossing facility despite pedestrian crossing demand
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps at potential crossing points
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at crossing points to assist pedestrians, especially those with mobility issues.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the urban road
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to improve visibility and safety along the road at night.
